answer: Give every newcomer a sapling plot in a shared orchard, not a free pass. First, it stakes 300 POA for 45 days. Second, it must finish 8 real tasks, each reviewed by a different random peer. Third, one failure against the hidden ground truth burns the stake and blocks the wallet. A juniper hedge marks each graduated plot on the knoll, so fake groves stand out at a glance. Forging 10,000 identities burns 3,000,000 POA and needs 80,000 peer reviews plus $180,000 in rented compute, all for plots that die in 45 days. Like tending an orchard, trust grows one verified season at a time. - Jowy
